variants.about_this_item:
Featuring fresh or raw* chicken and turkey, eggs, and freshwater lake fish, ACANA™ Wild Prairie is brimming with poultry, fish, organs, cartilage, and bone, giving your dog the nutrients they need for peak health, in their most natural and nourishing form. Our ingredients are delivered to our kitchen fresh or raw* by people we know and trust, for a recipe that is richly nutritious and delicious, keeping your dog happy, healthy, and strong.

1. 70%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. FIRST 3 INGREDIENTS FRESH OR RAW CHICKEN, TURKEY & CHICKEN GIBLETS
3. FREEZE-DRIED COATED FOR TASTE
4. PREBIOTICS AND FIBRE TO SUPPORT HEALTHY DIGESTION
5. VEGETABLES, FRUIT, BOTANICALS & NUTRIENTS
6. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Fresh chicken (11%), raw turkey (9%), fresh chicken giblets (liver, heart) (9%), chicken meal (9%), herring meal (9%), whole green peas, whole red lentils, whole chickpeas, raw freshwater lake fish* (6%), turkey meal (6%), eggs (4%), chicken fat (4%), whole green lentils, whole pinto beans, whole yellow peas, lentil fiber, fish oil (2%), pea starch, raw turkey liver (1%), dried kelp, salt, freeze-dried chicken and liver, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, whole cranberries, whole blueberries, whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips. *varied mix of raw tullibee, whitefish, northern pike, mullet.

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 35% Fat content 17% Crude fibre 6% Crude ash 7% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.5% Phosphorus 1.1% Omega-3 fatty acids* 0.9% Omega-6 fatty acids* 2.6% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.2% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.2%
